proof_ref:
by
  have s1 : -(G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℤ) ≥ -2 := by
    have hw := bipartite_chi_int G hp2
    try push_cast at hw
    linarith [hw]
  have s2 : -(Fintype.card V : ℤ) + (G.indepNum : ℤ) * (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℤ) ≥ 0 := by
    have hw := card_le_alpha_chi_int G

    linarith [hw]

      mul_nonneg (by linarith [s4]) (by linarith [s1])

    linarith [hmul]
  have s6 : -(Fintype.card V : ℤ) + (G.indepNum : ℤ) + (G.vertexCoverNum.toNat : ℤ) = 0 := by
    have hw := gallai_int G

    linarith [hw]
  have s7 : (Fintype.card V : ℤ) - 2 * (G.vertexCoverNum.toNat : ℤ) - 2 * (G.radius.toNat : ℤ) ≥ -4 := by linarith [s1, s2, s3, s5, s6]
  have heq_gallai := gallai_int G
  try push_cast at heq_gallai
  linarith [s7, heq_gallai]
